description: Starts creating a fund for the user: an SPV or a blind pool, with its legal name, expected allocation, strategy, classes and fees, manager and documents. Capital Company’s assistant asks for what is missing and, when it has everything, puts the fund to the user for confirmation before anything is created.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_create_fund
title: Create a fund
